subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Letter-sound relationships of some single letters; names 2 vowels and at least 6 consonants

show.line: New sounds! h, h, hat. o, o, octopus. g, g, goat. Listen for them.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with h, as in hat?
Tap the letter that says g.
Say the sound with me. o, as in octopus!
Which one starts with g, as in goat?
Which word has o in the middle? Listen. Hot, hat.
Trace h with your finger. Tall line down, then up and over the hump.
Does it start with h or g? Sort the pictures.

hints: Listen for the first sound. h is a little puff of air.
g comes from the back of your throat. g, g.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with g.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Hat starts with h. Goat starts with g.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. g, g, goat. Goat starts with g!

parent_line: Can hear and recognise the sounds h, o and g.
